test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A person uses a rectangular metallic sheet of 45 m × 30 m for making an open box. From each corner of the sheet he cut offs a square. If the length of one side of each of these squares is 10 m, then what will be the volume of the box (in m³)?
solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of a rectangular sheet = 45× 30

Length of side of square = 10 m

**Formula used:**

Volume = l × b × h 

Where l = length 

 b = breadth 

 h = height 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ed36350a01fb4f5a4e2c0846e7292a9af912f6977b3abd7f4da265ddb1c9af.png] 

As, a square is cut off from each corner

⇒ Hence, 2 squares are cut off from each side

⇒ length = 45 - 2(10) = 45 -20 =25m

⇒ breadth = 30 -2 (10) = 30 -20 = 10 m

⇒ height = side of the square = 10m

⇒ Volume = l × b × h = 25 × 10 × 10 = 2500 m³

** Hence, the required volume is 2500 m³ .**
